em_2mlr.takeaway: Noiseless population EM iterates trace a cycloid in two-component mixed linear regression, revealing their superlinear convergence.

softmax_switchgd.takeaway: A single-loop, primal-only method for distributed minimax optimization with stochastic constraints, covering full and partial client participation.

em_2mlr_nosepara.takeaway: How mixing-weight initialization shapes EM convergence in overspecified mixed linear regression, with population and finite-sample guarantees.

diffusion_2mlr.takeaway: Connecting score matching, maximum likelihood, and EM in mixed linear regression with unknown mixing weights.

rampage.takeaway: Randomized midpoint estimators remove discretization bias in gradient extrapolation under the analyzed operator and game assumptions.

variance_reduced.takeaway: A unified high-probability framework for variance-reduced estimation, with improved oracle complexity for expectation-constrained optimization.

em_2mlr_structural.takeaway: A trajectory-based analysis of EM, with explicit updates, finite-sample guarantees, and convergence from arbitrary initialization.

panicle.takeaway: GAN-generated UAV imagery augments training data to improve sorghum panicle detection and counting.

extract_laser.takeaway: Robust laser-stripe segmentation for multi-camera structured-light measurement and 3D reconstruction.

smart_ladle.takeaway: Machine learning for steel casting-temperature prediction, tested and deployed at Steel Dynamics’ Butler Division.

multi_ransac1.takeaway: A multi-level RANSAC approach for multi-camera, multi-laser structured-light vision.

multi_ransac2.takeaway: Evaluating multi-level RANSAC against time-division and color-division approaches for structured-light vision.

antithetic.title: Generalized Antithetic Variance Reduction: an Optimal Transport Approach
antithetic.takeaway: Designing distribution-preserving antithetic maps through optimal transport to reduce variance in Monte Carlo and stochastic optimization.
antithetic.summary: Ongoing work on strong antithetic maps and indices that maximize negative dependence while preserving a target distribution, connecting antithetic coupling with geometric optimal transport for Monte Carlo integration, approximation, and stochastic optimization.
